sourceTitle: The Gold-Seekers: A Tale of California
description: "The Gold-Seekers: A Tale of California" by Gustave Aimard is a novel written in the mid-19th century. This adventurous narrative focuses on the dramatic experiences of a group of characters exploring California during the gold rush era, emphasizing their interactions with the land and each other.
